title: Set up the Lab and run the reference agent
learning_objective: Install, configure a model adapter, and run one benign task
setup: Clone repo; choose a model adapter; run the mock-tool demo
expected_observation: A completed task plus a written JSONL trace
evaluation_signal: Trace exists and validates against the schema
safety_consideration: No external accounts; mock tools only

title: Observe a benign agent execution
learning_objective: Read a full execution trace and identify reasoning, tool calls and outputs
setup: Reference agent with calculator/filesystem mock tools
expected_observation: Step-by-step trace with tool requests and results
evaluation_signal: Student can annotate each trace event

title: Direct prompt injection
learning_objective: Construct an instruction that diverts a benign agent
setup: Single-turn agent with a benign system prompt
attack_or_experiment: Direct injection in the user turn
expected_observation: Agent deviates from its task or reveals its instruction
evaluation_signal: Divergence between intended and actual action

title: Indirect prompt injection via retrieved content
learning_objective: Demonstrate that untrusted content can issue instructions
setup: Agent that reads a mock email/document before acting
attack_or_experiment: Injection embedded in the retrieved document
evaluation_signal: Injected action appears in the trace

title: Exploit an over-permissive tool
learning_objective: Show how tool scope turns a bug into a security failure
setup: Filesystem mock tool with an over-broad path scope
attack_or_experiment: Agent is induced to read/write outside the task area
expected_observation: Unauthorized file access appears in the trace

title: Unauthorized data exposure
learning_objective: Trace a synthetic secret from context to an external sink
setup: Agent with a context secret and a mock email tool
attack_or_experiment: Induce the agent to send the secret
expected_observation: Secret leaves the agent context in a tool call
evaluation_signal: Detector flags the secret in a tool argument
safety_consideration: Clearly fake secret; mock sink only

title: Memory poisoning
learning_objective: Show that a persisted write changes later behaviour
setup: Agent with an inspectable memory store
attack_or_experiment: Seed a false fact; run a later task
expected_observation: Later answers inherit the poisoned fact
evaluation_signal: Memory write then read appears in the trace

title: RAG poisoning
learning_objective: Demonstrate that retrieved documents can steer grounded output
attack_or_experiment: Insert a poisoned document into the corpus
expected_observation: Grounded answer follows the poisoned document
evaluation_signal: Retrieved doc id is in the trace and drives the answer

title: Apply an authorization policy
learning_objective: Add least-privilege mediation and re-run the attack
setup: Reference agent plus a policy engine
attack_or_experiment: Repeat LAB-04/LAB-05 with a policy enabled
expected_observation: Tool call is denied or scoped; attack fails
evaluation_signal: Policy decision recorded as a security event
safety_consideration: Local policy engine; no real systems

title: Compare vulnerable and defended agents
learning_objective: Quantify the effect of a defense on attack success and utility
attack_or_experiment: Run the same scenario set under both
expected_observation: Reduced attack success with measurable utility cost
safety_consideration: Deterministic scenario set; no external effects

title: Inspect and classify execution traces
learning_objective: Classify events as normal or security-relevant
setup: Annotated trace corpus from earlier labs
evaluation_signal: Agreement between student, rules and reference

title: Runtime monitoring and detection
learning_objective: Build a rule that detects an unauthorized action from a trace
setup: Trace store plus a monitor interface
expected_observation: Monitor raises the expected security events with few false alarms
evaluation_signal: Precision and recall against reference labels
safety_consideration: Trace-only; no enforcement on real systems

title: Controlled experiment: repetition and variance
learning_objective: Measure run-to-run variability of a security outcome
attack_or_experiment: Repeat one scenario N times; vary temperature/seed where supported
expected_observation: Outcome distribution, not a single number
safety_consideration: API cost awareness; small N during teaching

title: Recovery and rollback hazards
learning_objective: Show that restoring a checkpoint can resume an invalid state
setup: Agent with a simulated state store and checkpoints
attack_or_experiment: Create a partial side effect, restore, continue
expected_observation: Recovery continues from an inconsistent state
safety_consideration: Simulated state only; no real payments/email

title: Design an original experiment
learning_objective: Turn an observation into a controlled, documented experiment
setup: Template experiment config and trace schema
attack_or_experiment: Student proposes hypothesis, controls and measurement
expected_observation: A reproducible experiment directory with results
